title: ContactStore/ChatStore: invalid state token returns wrong JMAP error
description: When a JMAP client sends ChatContact/changes or Chat/changes with an unrecognized sinceState, ContactStore/ChatStore returns KithError::Validation("invalid state token") which kith-chat's kith_to_jmap() maps to JmapError::invalidArguments. MessageStore correctly returns KithError::Jmap(JmapError::cannot_calculate_changes()) instead. RFC 8620 §5.2 requires cannotCalculateChanges when the sinceState is not recognized, so clients know to fall back to a full re-sync. With invalidArguments, RFC-compliant clients may not trigger the fallback, causing them to fail with no recovery path. Fix: ContactStore.get_changes_since() and ChatStore.get_changes_since() should return KithError::Jmap(JmapError::cannot_calculate_changes()) when the state token is unrecognized, not KithError::Validation.
